send_level_note: docs/ge7_plan.md: the passive reamp path saturates above about -12 dBFS; train_signal_v2 peaks at -2 dBFS, so send at -10 dB.

map.note: Slider map: each slider alone at +15, +7.5, -7.5 and -15 dB with the sweep-only signal; the fit gives centre frequency, Q/bandwidth and gain per position.

preset_notes.flat: Every slider at the centre detent. The pedal should be close to a wire: this is the reference every other preset is compared with, and the calibration preset. A good flat take nulls almost completely against the send.
preset_notes.all_down: All seven bands at -12 dB and LEVEL at -15 dB. The most attenuation the pedal does: checks the noise floor and how the bands sum when they all cut together.
preset_notes.all_up: All seven bands at +12 dB and LEVEL at +15 dB. The most gain the pedal does: the stress test for headroom and clipping inside the pedal.
preset_notes.all_up_2: Same settings as all_up, recaptured in the Studio One days at a lower DAW fader to avoid ADC clipping. With the rig, the send level and calibration handle that; keep it for comparison with the old captures.
preset_notes.all_up_3: All bands +12 dB with LEVEL only at +6 dB: the band boosts without the extra output gain, so the EQ shape is measured clean of any clipping.
preset_notes.bass_boost: 100 Hz +12, 200 Hz +8, 400 Hz +4, the rest flat: a broad low-end lift that fades into the mids. Tests how neighbouring low bands overlap.
preset_notes.bright: 800 Hz +2, 1.6k +6, 3.2k +10, 6.4k +12: a rising top end, 'Strat sparkle'. Exercises the 6.4k band, which behaves like a high shelf rather than a peak.
preset_notes.frown: The inverse of smile: lows and highs cut, mids up to +8 dB at 800 Hz. A mid-forward voicing that tests boosts and cuts next to each other.
preset_notes.high_cut: 1.6k -6, 3.2k -10, 6.4k -14: rolls off the highs (telephone, muffled, vintage). Checks the deepest top-end cut.
preset_notes.low_cut: 100 Hz -14, 200 Hz -10, 400 Hz -6: an approximate high-pass. Checks the deepest low-end cut.
preset_notes.mid_scoop: 400 Hz -8, 800 Hz -12, 1.6k -10, 3.2k -4: the classic metal scoop. A deep notch made from three adjacent cuts.
preset_notes.presence: 1.6k +6, 3.2k +10, 6.4k +12 (bright without the 800 Hz touch): upper-mid and treble lift for cutting through a mix.
preset_notes.smile: The V shape: 100 Hz +8, 200 Hz +4, 400 Hz -2, 800 Hz and 1.6k -6, 3.2k +4, 6.4k +8. The most common GE-7 setting, and a good all-round test of the model.
preset_notes.warm: Lows up (+6/+4/+2), highs down (-4/-8/-10): warm and dark, an old-amp or jazz voicing. The tilt test.
